findings.explanation: The invoice and receipt both state INR 118,000.00 while the bank statement and ledger entry both record a debit of INR 129,800.00, an unexplained overpayment of INR 11,800.00 with no debit note or revised invoice supporting it.
PO-1011 is referenced by both the invoice and the receipt but no purchase order document was supplied at all, so approved amount, terms, and vendor cannot be verified.
